response.sql: WITH rating_metrics AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) as avg_length, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) as per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), cross_rating_mean AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) as mean_per_day_price FROM rating_metrics), above_mean_ratings AS (SELECT rm.rating, rm.avg_length, rm.per_day_price, crm.mean_per_day_price, rm.per_day_price - crm.mean_per_day_price as excess FROM rating_metrics rm CROSS JOIN cross_rating_mean crm WHERE rm.per_day_price > crm.mean_per_day_price) SELECT AVG(avg_length) as avg_of_avg_lengths, AVG(per_day_price) as avg_of_per_day_prices, AVG(excess) as avg_excess_over_mean FROM above_mean_ratings
